CustomField.description: PacPoint-IC051419 - Created for BREG phase 1 Calculates the Timeframe based on the Timeframe Count Months field. Returns how many months has passed.
CustomField.formula:
IF( TimeframeCountMonths__c <> -1,
IF(TimeframeCountMonths__c < 6, "0-6 months", "")+ IF(TimeframeCountMonths__c >= 6 && TimeframeCountMonths__c < 12 , "6-12 months", "")+ IF(TimeframeCountMonths__c >= 12 && TimeframeCountMonths__c < 18 , "12-18 months", "")+ IF(TimeframeCountMonths__c >= 18 && TimeframeCountMonths__c < 24 , "18-24 months", "")+ IF(TimeframeCountMonths__c >= 24 , "> 24 months", ""),
"" )
CustomField.label: Timeframe
